title: Time and Synchronicity
excerpt: A 2D bug crossing sheets of paper it can't perceive as separate — and God as a thirteenth-dimensional sphere casting shadows down to us.

sections.kicker: In response to: "why does the fact that we can move faster or slower through time mean that everything is happening at once? what's the train of thought to get to that conclusion?"
body: i only brought it up as evidence to show that time is not a linear concept. and once that evidence becomes like an if statement, like ig in coding terms, then the possibility that time is an illusion now opens up.
aka basically saying forget what u think u know about time.

time is a physical attribute and there also could be a possibility that it is our consciousness that defines all of reality including time. its weird how much u realize may be possible once u see the power of the subconscious mind.

cuz also if you think about the implications of what synchronicity is — if its true, then theres some connection between the past and future. aka there is a dimension (the 4th dimension maybe aka time) that we dont experience first hand but that physically connects the present with the future. that allows synchronicity, and like people who know the future and are given information of whats about to happen.

it shows that time isn't linear and even in the present moment information of the future exists. and ide assume its extra dimensional (4d+) cuz we don't experience it until the future. but in 4d space technically the future and past already exist in one.

aka like if for a 2d bug that lives on a 2 dimensional sheet of paper. lets say his time dimension is 3d space. so as seconds go he crosses to a new sheet of paper. the bug doesn't experience it, it has sheets of paper passing by. but us 3d beings can easily see that there is a stack of papers the bug keeps passing thru.
hopefully that makes it easier to conceptualize.

so part of the reason i wanna say its all happening at once is because, why would i stop at 4d. something so powerful and so extra dimensional just allows reality to exist. ima assume there are many other upper dimensions that go past 4d. or the "time dimension" that our "own time dimension" experiences. its almost impossible to explain with words or effectively convey what i am imagining based on what i've experienced. but ultimately, one arrives at the conclusion that there is a "highest" spacial dimension, maybe the "omni" dimension, or aka God, or source. the one. the thing that allows everything else to exist.
and this actually gets into super geometry and non-euclidian space.

so to conceptualize what i may even be talking about by omni dimension. lets say there is a sphere. and that 3 dimensional sphere is GOD. if we shine a light pointing at the sphere, on the wall we can see a 2 dimensional shadow. THAT 2d shadow is reality. thats what material is, it is the slowest and densest form. what am i saying. lets say GOD is a 13th dimensional sphere. and there is a light that casts a 12d shadow. and that 12d shadow has 11th d shadows. all the way down to the 3rd dimension. **thats what we are. we are a shadow of god's perfection.**
this all at a 7 in the scale to me.
